head.text: Expansion card read (32-bit region, current logic, 20 MHz)

signal.name: state
signal.data: S0 S1 S2 S3 S4 S5 S0 S1 S2 S3

foot.text: BUSCTRL acknowledges the whole 8/16/32-bit region two levels after AS, so a card gets no wait states whatever it does with nEXP_DEV_WAIT. It has about 4 slots (50 ns at 20 MHz) from nEXP_xxBDEV to valid data at the connector. U54-U57 are always enabled and nEXP_DATA_EN only sets their direction. A card must drive it high again as soon as its select ends: with only the 10K pull-up the buffers keep driving the CPU data bus into the next cycle.
